title: Your First Script
story: Chilaka found a plain text file that does things. A shell script is just commands saved in order.
goal: Print the line Hello, AataKode! using echo.
hints: echo prints its arguments and adds a newline.
Put the text in quotes: echo "..."
socratic: What does a shell run first, the top line or the bottom line?
Why are quotes useful around text with spaces?
What did echo add at the end of the line?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Your First Script”?
